column7: Outermost layer: puts the published generation on every request before auth, so every later judgement on the request reads one configuration; a missing pin is refused downstream, never replaced by the current one.
Reads the request's pinned generation for the readers that judge it; returns None for a request that never passed the pin layer, which its callers refuse.
The generation a queued dispatch or resume step takes and judges by: its authorizer and its re-admission read this one value.
